title: 3 free checks before you launch your AI-built app
intro: AI writes code fast, but it repeats the same mistakes. These three checks take about ten minutes.
reel: From the reel: You built an app with AI. Check these before you launch

tools.name: 1. Gitleaks: leaked passwords and keys
tools.what: Scans your project for passwords, API keys and tokens that ended up in the code. Leaked keys are how people get surprise bills.

copy.label: Scan your project's git history (run inside the project folder)

tools.name: 2. npm audit: known security holes
tools.what: Comes with npm. It checks the packages your app uses against a list of known vulnerabilities and tells you how to fix them.

copy.label: Fix what can be fixed automatically

tools.name: 3. Lighthouse: slow, broken on phones, hard to use
tools.what: Built into Chrome. It scores your page for performance, accessibility, SEO and more, and lists what to fix.

sections.heading: Run Lighthouse
steps: Open your site in Chrome on a computer.
Click Analyze page load and wait 30 to 60 seconds.

note: Three checks, ten minutes. That's the part AI doesn't do for you.
